author: Gamer10023
quote: I waited over ten years for this game, and I've never been this disappointed.Start with the chores. A huge part of the game is busywork: errands, jobs, daily-life tasks that come down to mashing one button while an animation plays. There's no skill and no real gameplay in it. It's filler made to look like content.Then there are the protagonists. Lucia and Jason are hard to like and harder to care about. GTA always gave you characters you loved playing even when they were terrible people. These two just feel flat, and spending 40+ hours with them is a chore of its **** biggest problem is the lack of freedom. The whole point of GTA was that the world was yours, and you could cause chaos anywhere. Here, whole areas won't let you shoot or fight. When the series built its name on freedom, putting fences around the fun defeats the purpose.Overall it doesn't feel like a game. It feels like a string of cutscenes stitched together with a little playtime in between. You spend more time watching than **** critics deserve their own paragraph. Seeing the scores this game got, it's clear gamers can't trust them anymore. Too many reviewers seem more interested in staying on the developer's good side than in being honest with the people who actually buy the game. They should be ashamed. Their job is to tell us the truth, not to protect their **** used to be raw, bold, unapologetic, and a little dangerous. GTA 6 is the opposite of what it was supposed to be. The series that was a triumph of attitude went completely soft.
